title: Boss: Who Is Guessing Passwords?
story: Someone is hammering the server. Find the address with the most failed logins.
goal: Print the address and count of the worst offender, using at most 6 parts.

tests.label: Hidden data check
tests.input:
Failed 1.1.1.1 a
Failed 2.2.2.2 b
Failed 2.2.2.2 c
OK 1.1.1.1 d

hints: Think about what each part does to the lines.
Try the parts one at a time and watch the output change.
grep Failed | awk '{print $2}' | sort | uniq -c | sort -nr | head -n 1
socratic: What should the first part do?
What does the data look like after each part?
Compare your result with the goal. What differs?
explain: In one sentence: what does each part of your pipeline do?
solution: grep Failed | awk '{print $2}' | sort | uniq -c | sort -nr | head -n 1
